summary: Verified full mobile responsiveness at 390x844 for Puff2Door and desktop sanity at 1920x800. All 12 storefront pages and all 12 admin pages report document.documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal page overflow). Age gate, hamburger drawer, mobile search, product add-to-cart, cart page + PUFF10 promo apply, admin login, chat launcher (icon-only 52x52 mobile / 'Chat with us' label desktop), and desktop header (tagline PUFFS DELIVERED TO YOUR DOOR + Wishlist/Cart labels) all working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Two search inputs exist in the header DOM at mobile viewport (desktop one hidden via CSS). Not a bug — just note both share placeholder 'Search for products, brands...'; testing scripts need to select the visible one.
test_credentials: admin@puff2door.com / Puff2Door-Admin1 — login successful, redirects to /
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness verified end-to-end at 390x844. Storefront pages tested: /, /shop, /shop/silly-dots-super-dose-mushroom-pills-2400mg-tab-3ct-1, /cart, /checkout, /my-account (logged out & in), /track, /delivery-area, /about, /contact, /brands, /wishlist — all scrollWidth=390. Admin pages tested logged-in: /admin, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/chat, /admin/loyalty, /admin/settings, /admin/brands, /admin/categories, /admin/banners, /admin/promos, /admin/emails, /admin/alerts — all scrollWidth=390. Cart+PUFF10 apply keeps sw=390. Chat launcher mobile is icon-only 52x52 at bottom-right; desktop shows 'Chat with us' label. Age gate 'Yes, I am 21+' works. Desktop 1920 sanity for /, /shop, /checkout, /admin/products all fit.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Mobile responsive fixes (header sizing, overflow-x hidden, img max-width, admin table wrapper overflow-x-auto, cart promo row, chat launcher icon-only) are all functioning correctly.
